tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Performance Preparation and Assessment

questions.question: Describe how performance preparation and assessment are used in a piece of music you have studied. Use musical vocabulary.
questions.correctAnswer: A detailed description using precise musical vocabulary (e.g. specific terms from the AQA elements list), referencing a named piece with accurate observations about how the elements are used and their effect.

questions.question: Compare how two different pieces use performance preparation and assessment. Explain the effect in each case.
questions.correctAnswer: A comparison of two pieces identifying similarities and differences in how performance preparation and assessment are used, explaining the different effects created in each musical context, using comparative language.

questions.question: How could you use performance preparation and assessment in your own composition or performance? Explain your choices.
questions.correctAnswer: A practical application showing understanding of how performance preparation and assessment can be manipulated in composition or performance, with specific examples of choices made and their intended effect.

tests.name: Extended Practice
tests.description: Self-marked extended answers on Performance Preparation and Assessment

questions.question: Full-Mark Response Create a preparation timeline for your performing component, from initial repertoire choice through to final recording. Include strategies for dealing with performance anxiety and ensuring your best performance on the day. <div class="
questions.correctAnswer: A grade 9 response will: create a realistic, detailed timeline; include specific practice strategies for each stage; address performance anxiety with practical techniques; explain recording and submission requirements; demonstrate understanding of the NEA administration process. Mark scheme: AO3 (analyse and evaluate) + AO4 (knowledge and understanding) = total marks for listening; AO1 (perform) + AO2 (compose) for coursework components
questions.explanation: Extended answer: aim for the mark-scheme points, in order, with the command word addressed.
